sn44.1:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || 2
sn44.1:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Khemā bhikkhunī Kosalesu cārikam caramānā antarā ca Sāvatthiṃ antarā ca Sāketaṃ Toraṇavatthusmiṃ vāsām upagatā hoti || || 3
sn44.1:1.3: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi Kosalo Sāketā Sāvatthiṃ gacchanto antarā ca Sāketam antarā cā Sāvatthiṃ Toraṇavatthusmim ekarattivāsam upagacchi || || 4
sn44.1:1.4: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi Kosalo aññataram purisam āmantesi ||
sn44.1:1.5: Ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa Toraṇavatthusmiṃ tathārūpaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā jāna yam aham ajja payirūpāseyyanti || ||
sn44.1:2.1: Evaṃ devāti kho so puriso rañño Pasenadissa Kosalassa paṭissutvā kevalakappaṃ Toraṇavatthusmim āhiṇḍanto nāddasa tathārūpaṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā yaṃ rājā Pasenadi Kosalo payirūpāseyya || || 5
sn44.1:2.2: Addasa kho so puriso Khemam bhikkhuniṃ Toraṇavatthusmiṃ vāsam upagataṃ || ||
sn44.1:2.3: Disvāna yena rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā rājānaṃ Pasenadi-Kosalam etad avoca || ||
sn44.1:3.1: Natthi kho devā Toraṇavatthusmim tathārūpo samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā yam devo payirupāseyya ||
sn44.1:3.2: atthi ca kho deva Khemā nāma bhikkhunī tassa Bhagavato sāvikā arahato sammāsambuddhassa ||
sn44.1:3.3: tassā kho pana ayyāya evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato ||
sn44.1:3.4: paṇḍitā viyattā medhāvinī bahussutā cittakathī kalyāṇapaṭibhānā ti ||
sn44.1:4.1: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo yena Khemā bhikkhunī tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Khemam bhikkhunim abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 7 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo Khemam bhikkhunim etad avoca || ||
sn44.1:4.2: Kiṃ nu kho ayye hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.1:4.5: Kim pana ayye na hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti || ||
sn44.1:4.6: Tam pi kho mahārāja avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.1:4.7: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 9
sn44.1:4.8: Kiṃ nu kho ayye hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato parammaraṇā ti || ||
sn44.1:4.10: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti || || 10
sn44.1:4.11: Kimpanayye neva hoti na nahoti tathāgato parammaraṇāti || ||
sn44.1:4.13: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || || 11
sn44.1:5.1: Kiṃ nu kho ayye Hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti iti puṭṭhā samānā
sn44.1:5.4: Kim panayye Na hoti tathagato param maraṇāti iti puṭṭhā samānā
sn44.1:5.5: Etam pi kho mahārāja avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.1:5.6: Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti vadesi || ||
sn44.1:5.7: Kiṃ nu kho ayye Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti iti puṭṭhā samānā
sn44.1:5.9: Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || ||
sn44.1:5.10: Kiṃ nu kho Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇati iti puṭṭhā samānā
sn44.1:5.11: Etam pi kho mahārāja avyākatam Bhagavatā
sn44.1:5.12: Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti vadesi || ||
sn44.1:5.13: Ko nu kho ayye hetu ko paccayo yena tam avyākatam Bhagavatā ti || || 12
sn44.1:6.1: Tena hi mahārāja taññevettha paṭipucchissāmi || yathā te khameyya tathā naṃ vyākareyyāsi || || 13
sn44.1:6.3: atthi te koci gaṇako va muddiko vā saṅkhāyako vā yo pahoti Gaṅgāya vālukam gaṇetum
sn44.1:6.4: Ettakā vālukā iti vā Ettakāni vālukasatāni iti vā Ettakāni vālukasahassāni iti vā Ettakāni vālukasatasahassānīti vā ti || ||
sn44.1:6.6: Atthi pana te koci gaṇako vā muddiko vā saṅkhāyako vā yo pahoti mahāsamudde udakaṃ manituṃ
sn44.1:6.7: Ettakāni udakāḷhakāni iti va Ettakāni udakāḷhakasatāni iti vā Ettakāni udakāḷhakasahassāni iti vā Ettakāni udakāḷhakasatasahassānī ti vā ti || ||
sn44.1:6.11: Evam eva kho mahārāja yena rūpena tathāgatam paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya || taṃ rūpaṃ tathāgatassa pahīnam ucchinnamūlam tālāvatthukatam anabhāvakatam āyatim anuppādakataṃ || ||
sn44.1:6.12: Rūpasaṅkhāya vimutto kho mahārāja tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho
sn44.1:6.14: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti pi na upeti || Na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā ti pi na upeti || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi na upeti || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti pi na upeti || || 16
sn44.1:7.1: Yāya vedanāya tathāgatam paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya || sā vedanā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādadhammā || ||
sn44.1:7.2: Vedanāsaṅkhāya vimutto kho mahārāja tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho
sn44.1:7.4: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti pi na upeti || Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇāti pi na upeti || Hoti ca na hoti- || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti na upeti || || 17
sn44.1:8.2: Yehi saṅkhārehi tathāgatam paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya || te saṅkhārā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvakatā āyatim anuppādhammā || ||
sn44.1:8.3: Saṅkhārasaṅkhāya vimutto kho mahārāja tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho
sn44.1:8.5: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi na upeti || Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti na upeti || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi na upeti || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi na upeti || || 19
sn44.1:9.1: Yena viññāṇena tathāgatam paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya || tam viññāṇam tathāgatassa pahīnam ucchinnamūlaṃ talāvatthukatam anabhāvakatam āyatim anuppādadhammaṃ ||
sn44.1:9.2: viññāṇasaṅkhāya vimutto kho mahārāja tathāgato gambhiro appameyyo duppariyogāho
sn44.1:9.4: Hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi na upeti || Na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi na upeti || Hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi na upeti || Neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti pi na upetīti || || 20
sn44.1:9.5: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo Khemāya bhikkhuniyā bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Khemam bhikkhuniṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 21
sn44.1:10.1: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo aparena samayena yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || 22 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho rājā Pasenadi-Kosalo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn44.1:10.2: Kiṃ nu kho bhante hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.1:10.5: Kim pana bhante na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā ti || ||
sn44.1:10.6: Etam pi kho mahārāja avyākataṃ mayā
